The selected-root quantity is a lower bound for the complete nonnegative ledger, with the bounded Lambda1 factor and fixed multiplier constant omitted from the plotted normalization. The points corroborate but do not prove the infinite-lattice root theorem, the negative-Sobolev action theorem, the Malliavin density input, Navier-Stokes regularity, singularity formation, or a Millennium-problem solution.
